 The giallorossi squad for Roma-Slovan Bratislava
 October 20, 2026 
 Copy 
 Gian Piero Gasperini has released the squad list for Roma-Slovan Bratislava, Matchday 3 of the Champions League. 
 Here are the players available to the coach.
 Goalkeepers:  Vasquez, De Marzi, Gollini
 Defenders:  Rensch, Koulierakis, Ndicka, Molina, Hermoso, Mancini, Balerdi, Wesley, Lulli, Ghilardi
 Midfielders:  Cristante, Pellegrini, De Roon, Pisilli, Di Nunzio, Mora 
 Forwards:  Castro, Malen, Soulé
